name_note: The literature name for GTDB R232 g__Saccharimonas is Candidatus Saccharimonas, a genus of the Candidatus Saccharibacteria (formerly TM7) whose only named species here is Candidatus Saccharimonas aalborgensis; the oral TM7 strain TM7x (Candidatus Nanosynbacter lyticus) belongs to a different GTDB genus and is not covered.

sentences.text: Candidatus Saccharimonas aalborgensis is an uncultivated bacterium of the Candidate Phyla Radiation, a group described as having reduced genomes and limited metabolic capacities.
A study reported that a predicted glutamate racemase from Candidatus Saccharimonas aalborgensis restored the growth of a Salmonella d-glutamate auxotroph lacking its endogenous racemase.
That study concluded that Candidatus Saccharimonas aalborgensis may couple glutamate racemization to incorporation of serine and d-glutamate into the stem peptide of peptidoglycan.
In a feasibility study of saliva from 10 orthodontic patients, quantitative analysis showed a positive correlation between changes in bleeding on probing and Candidatus Saccharimonas aalborgensis.
